# PRD — Slice 4: Intake & Eligibility CRD/DTR

**Status:** Proposed  
**Sprint target:** Sprint 4 (following Sprint FI live-integration close)  
**Owner:** Platform Engineering  
**Last updated:** 2026-07-19  
**Depends on:** S2 Initial-PA lifecycle (live), S3 TierRouter (live), S3 Slice 4b resume endpoint (live), P7a Tenancy (live), Sprint FI live-wiring (in progress)  
**Referenced ADRs:** ADR-0001 (LangGraph orchestrator), ADR-0002 (provider-neutral LLM), ADR-0003 (deterministic gatekeeper), ADR-0009 (idempotency/audit), ADR-0010 (in-memory checkpointer), ADR-0013 (BFF session auth), ADR-0017 (tenancy)

---

## 1. Problem Summary

The current initial-PA pipeline implements a **stub CRD** (Coverage Requirements Discovery): it resolves PA requirements by looking up an internal `pa_requirements.json` registry and treats a registry miss as "no PA required." This is explicitly flagged in `02-backend-architecture.md` and `05-state-lifecycle.md` as acceptable only while the registry is the authoritative source.

Two related gaps exist:

1. **CRD stub leaks false negatives.** A registry miss reads as "not required," when the real answer from the payer CRD endpoint may be "required with specific questionnaire." This silently skips PA for drugs/plans not yet in the local registry.
2. **DTR (Documentation Templates and Rules) is completely absent.** After a payer CRD endpoint confirms PA is required, it returns a FHIR Questionnaire (the DTR IG) that the provider must complete before the PA can be assembled. Today the system assembles the PA from the request's `criteria_results` without validating that the payer's mandatory documentation template has been answered.

Together these gaps mean the system cannot faithfully implement the Da Vinci CRD → DTR → PAS chain required for compliant payer integration. The stub is acceptable for a demo but blocks any real payer onboarding.

---

## 2. Goals

| # | Goal |
|---|------|
| G1 | Replace the stub `crd_check` node with a **real CRD client** that queries the payer's FHIR CRD endpoint (Da Vinci IG) and falls back gracefully to the existing registry on network/config failures |
| G2 | Add a **DTR node** that retrieves the payer-returned FHIR Questionnaire, maps it onto the case's `CriterionResult` evidence, and identifies unfilled mandatory items as documentation gaps |
| G3 | Surface documentation gaps as an `awaiting_documentation` lifecycle state with a structured gap list, allowing an operator to supply missing evidence without restarting the case |
| G4 | Preserve all existing guarantees: security-hold gate, terminal-event contract (`done`\|`error`), idempotent audit writes, TierRouter tiering, in-memory checkpointer compatibility |
| G5 | Remain adapter-accurate: the CRD client is an ETL adapter (`etl/crd/`); engine nodes never branch on payer identity |
| G6 | Provide a test seam that runs the full CRD→DTR→PAS chain in CI without any network calls (mock CRD server + mock DTR questionnaire fixture) |

---

## 3. Non-Goals

| # | Non-Goal |
|---|----------|
| NG1 | Implementing a full SMART on FHIR / OAuth2 payer auth handshake (a new ADR governs payer credential management; this slice wires a pre-provisioned token) |
| NG2 | Parsing every possible FHIR Questionnaire item type — only `boolean`, `choice`, and `text` items are in scope for MVP |
| NG3 | Building a UI questionnaire-filling form (the DTR gap list surfaces in the existing queue workspace exception panel; a dedicated questionnaire UI is a follow-on slice) |
| NG4 | Replacing the PAS rail or changing the X12-278 adapter shape |
| NG5 | Multi-payer CRD routing table (one payer CRD endpoint per tenant, resolved from tenant config; multi-payer expansion is a future platform capability) |
| NG6 | Durable PostgreSQL storage (still the Phase 3 milestone; this slice inherits the in-memory store) |

---

## 4. Requirements

### Functional

| ID | Requirement | Priority |
|----|-------------|----------|
| F1 | `crd_check` node MUST query the configured payer CRD FHIR endpoint (`POST /cds-hooks/order-sign`) when `PAYER_CRD_BASE_URL` is set for the case's tenant | P0 |
| F2 | When the CRD endpoint is unavailable or the tenant has no configured endpoint, `crd_check` MUST fall back to the existing registry lookup and set `crd_resolution = "registry_fallback"` on the state | P0 |
| F3 | The CRD response MUST be parsed into `PaRequired` + optional `FhirQuestionnaire` reference; the questionnaire reference MUST be stored on `InitialPaState.dtr_questionnaire_ref` | P0 |
| F4 | When the CRD response includes a `dtr_questionnaire_ref`, the new `dtr_check` node MUST fetch the FHIR Questionnaire and evaluate it against `criteria_results` | P0 |
| F5 | Unfilled mandatory Questionnaire items MUST be emitted as `DocumentationGap` objects on `InitialPaState.documentation_gaps` | P0 |
| F6 | When `documentation_gaps` is non-empty, the pipeline MUST emit a `documentation_gap` step event and transition to the `awaiting_documentation` terminal (a new `InitialPaDoneEvent` variant field — not a new event type) | P0 |
| F7 | The `awaiting_documentation` path MUST write an `AuditRecord` with a new `outcome = "awaiting_documentation"` value before emitting the terminal event | P0 |
| F8 | A new `POST /api/pa/supply-docs` endpoint MUST accept a `SupplyDocsRequest` (correlation_id + list of `CriterionResult` additions), merge the new evidence, re-evaluate the DTR questionnaire, and re-enter the pipeline at `dtr_check` | P0 |
| F9 | Re-entry via `supply-docs` MUST produce its own `AuditRecord` with `provenance = "documentation_supplied"` and an incremented attempt counter | P1 |
| F10 | The `crd_check` node MUST emit a `crd_resolution` field on the terminal event: `"payer_crd"` \| `"registry_fallback"` \| `"not_required"` | P1 |
| F11 | All CRD/DTR network calls MUST go through the `CircuitBreaker` primitive already present in `ml/llm_backend.py` (extracted to a shared `utils/circuit_breaker.py` to avoid import coupling) | P1 |
| F12 | `crd_check` MUST enforce a 10-second timeout on the CRD endpoint; a timeout is treated identically to a network error (fallback to registry) | P1 |

### Non-Functional

| ID | Requirement |
|----|-------------|
| NF1 | The CRD client (`etl/crd/client.py`) MUST be injectable as a dependency so unit tests can supply a `MockCrdClient` without patching `httpx` globally |
| NF2 | The FHIR Questionnaire parser MUST have 100% branch coverage in unit tests — it is safety-critical (a missed mandatory item = a false clear) |
| NF3 | The CI smoke tour MUST cover the `awaiting_documentation` path end-to-end using mock fixtures |
| NF4 | PHI from CRD responses (patient identifiers in the CDS hook context) MUST pass through `redact_phi()` before any log write |
| NF5 | Adding `PAYER_CRD_BASE_URL` to `.env.example` with a documented format is required before merge |

---

## 5. Workflow Modeling

### 5.1 CRD/DTR-extended Initial-PA pipeline

```
POST /api/pa/submit
  │
  ▼
security_gate ──(hold)──→ error_event
  │
  ▼
pa_ingestion → InitialPaState
  │
  ▼
crd_check  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ pa_required=false (CRD or registry)                                      │
  ▼                                                                          │
done_event (early exit, no submission)                                       │
                                                                             │ pa_required=true
                                                                             ▼
                                                                        dtr_check
                                                                             │
                                                     ┌───────────────────────┤
                                                     │ gaps non-empty        │ gaps empty
                                                     ▼                       ▼
                                            documentation_gap           pa_assembly
                                            step event                       │
                                                     │                       ▼
                                                     ▼                  pas_submit
                                            done_event                       │
                                        (awaiting_documentation)             ▼
                                                     │              determination ⟲
                                                     │                       │
                                                     │                       ▼
                                        POST /api/pa/supply-docs      done_event
                                                     │
                                                     ▼
                                           merge evidence → dtr_check (re-entry)
```

### 5.2 Re-supply flow

```
Operator sees "awaiting_documentation" in queue workspace
  │
  ├── Attaches chart note / lab result CriterionResult additions
  │
  └── POST /api/pa/supply-docs {correlation_id, additional_criteria}
        │
        ▼
      resume checkpoint at dtr_check
        │
        ├── gaps still non-empty → another awaiting_documentation done
        └── gaps resolved → pa_assembly → pas_submit → determination → done
```

### 5.3 CRD resolution precedence

```
1. PAYER_CRD_BASE_URL configured for tenant?
   └── Yes → POST /cds-hooks/order-sign (10s timeout, circuit breaker)
             └── Success → crd_resolution = "payer_crd"
             └── Failure/Timeout → fall through to (2)
   └── No → fall through to (2)

2. plan_id in local registry?
   └── Yes → crd_resolution = "registry_fallback", pa_required = true
   └── No  → crd_resolution = "registry_fallback", pa_required = false
                (fail-open; flag in audit for manual review)
```

---

## 6. Data Model Changes

### 6.1 New types (backend/models/schemas.py)

```python
class CrdResolution(str, Enum):
    payer_crd       = "payer_crd"
    registry_fallback = "registry_fallback"
    not_required    = "not_required"

class DocumentationGap(BaseModel):
    item_link_id: str          # FHIR Questionnaire item linkId
    item_text: str             # Human-readable question text
    item_type: Literal["boolean", "choice", "text"]
    required: bool = True
    existing_answer: str | None = None  # None = not answered

class FhirQuestionnaireRef(BaseModel):
    questionnaire_url: str     # Canonical FHIR URL
    version: str | None = None

class SupplyDocsRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True)
    correlation_id: str        # The parked awaiting_documentation run's handle
    additional_criteria: list[CriterionResult]
    attempt: int = Field(default=1, ge=1)
```

### 6.2 InitialPaState additions

```python
class InitialPaState(TypedDict):
    # --- existing fields ---
    request: InitialPaRequest
    pa_required: PaRequired | None
    pa_context: str
    pa_resolution: PaResolution
    submission: PaSubmission | None
    submission_ref: str
    outcome: PaOutcome | None
    appeal_handoff: AppealHandoff | None
    # --- new fields ---
    crd_resolution: CrdResolution | None       # which CRD path fired
    dtr_questionnaire_ref: FhirQuestionnaireRef | None
    documentation_gaps: list[DocumentationGap]  # empty = no gaps
    supply_attempt: int                         # increments on each supply-docs re-entry
```

### 6.3 InitialPaDoneEvent additions

```python
class InitialPaDoneEvent(BaseModel):
    # --- existing ---
    event: Literal["done"] = "done"
    pa_required: PaRequired
    outcome: PaOutcome | None
    appeal_handoff: AppealHandoff | None
    submission_ref: str
    pa_resolution: PaResolution
    correlation_id: str
    # --- new ---
    crd_resolution: CrdResolution          # always present
    documentation_gaps: list[DocumentationGap]  # empty list when clear
    awaiting_documentation: bool           # True iff gaps non-empty at terminal
```

### 6.4 AuditRecord additions

```python
class AuditOutcome(str, Enum):
    done                   = "done"
    error                  = "error"
    awaiting_documentation = "awaiting_documentation"   # NEW

class AuditProvenance(str, Enum):
    as_is                  = "as_is"
    gatekeeper_corrected   = "gatekeeper_corrected"
    human_edited           = "human_edited"
    documentation_supplied = "documentation_supplied"   # NEW
```

### 6.5 Frontend parity

All new enums (`CrdResolution`, `AuditOutcome.awaiting_documentation`, `AuditProvenance.documentation_supplied`) MUST be mirrored in `src/types.ts` in the same commit. Parity enforced by `test_schema_parity.py`.

---

## 7. API Changes

### 7.1 Modified: `POST /api/pa/submit`

The terminal `done` event now carries `crd_resolution`, `documentation_gaps`, and `awaiting_documentation`. Clients that ignore unknown fields are unaffected; the typed client MUST update `src/lib/wire.ts` to surface the new fields.

Step events gain a new value: `"dtr_check"` (emitted after `"crd_check"` when a questionnaire is being evaluated).

### 7.2 New: `POST /api/pa/supply-docs`

**Auth:** dual scheme (Bearer or session cookie + CSRF).  
**No LLM** — this path re-enters the PA pipeline at `dtr_check`; no synthesis is invoked.

**Request body:**

| Field | Type | Constraint |
|-------|------|------------|
| `correlation_id` | str | 1–200 chars; the `awaiting_documentation` run's handle |
| `additional_criteria` | `CriterionResult[]` | ≥ 1 item |
| `attempt` | int ≥ 1 | default 1; increments with each re-supply |

**Events:** same step sequence as `POST /api/pa/submit` from `dtr_check` onward, then exactly one terminal `done` (cleared or still awaiting) or `error` (unknown/already-resolved correlation_id).

**Audit:** writes an `AuditRecord` with `provenance = "documentation_supplied"`, `idempotency_key = <correlation_id>:supply:<attempt>`.

**HTTP status codes:** identical to existing PA submit route (200 = stream started; 401/403/422 same semantics).

### 7.3 New environment variables

| Var | Required | Meaning |
|-----|----------|---------|
| `PAYER_CRD_BASE_URL` | no | Base URL for the payer CRD CDS Hooks endpoint. Unset = registry-fallback only |
| `PAYER_CRD_TOKEN` | when CRD configured | Bearer token for payer CRD auth. Stored in env; never logged |
| `CRD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | no | CRD request timeout; default 10 |

---

## 8. LangGraph Integration

### 8.1 Graph changes (backend/agents/initial_pa_graph.py)

The existing `StateGraph(InitialPaState)` gains two new nodes and one new conditional edge:

```
Existing:  pa_ingestion → crd_check → [pa_required?] → pa_assembly → pas_submit → determination ⟲ → finalize
New:       pa_ingestion → crd_check → [pa_required?] → dtr_check → [gaps?] → (pa_assembly | awaiting_doc_finalize)
```

**New nodes:**

| Node | File | Contract |
|------|------|----------|
| `dtr_check` | `agents/nodes/dtr_check.py` | `(InitialPaState) → InitialPaState`; fetches questionnaire (if `dtr_questionnaire_ref` set), maps `criteria_results` onto items, populates `documentation_gaps`; pure — HTTP call is injected via configurable |
| `awaiting_doc_finalize` | `agents/nodes/awaiting_doc_finalize.py` | `(InitialPaState) → InitialPaState`; emits `documentation_gap` step event, sets terminal fields; parks at `interrupt()` keyed by `thread_id` so `supply-docs` can re-enter |

**New conditional edge after `dtr_check`:**
```python
def _after_dtr_check(state: InitialPaState) -> str:
    return "awaiting_doc_finalize" if state["documentation_gaps"] else "pa_assembly"
```

**Re-entry via `supply-docs`:** `run_supply_docs(request, config)` in a new `agents/supply_docs.py` (parallel to `agents/resume.py`) merges `additional_criteria` into state via `Command(resume={"additional_criteria": …})` and re-enters at `dtr_check`. The compiled graph singleton (`_PA_PIPELINE`) is shared — no second compilation.

### 8.2 Checkpointer

`awaiting_doc_finalize` parks via `interrupt()` using the same `InMemorySaver` already present on the appeal graph. The PA graph MUST also compile with an `InMemorySaver` (currently it does not checkpoint — this is the slice that adds it).

`thread_id = correlation_id` for the PA graph, matching the appeal graph convention.

### 8.3 Purity invariant

`dtr_check` receives the CRD client as a `configurable` key, exactly as `llm_backend` is injected into the appeal graph. The node function signature stays `(state: InitialPaState) → InitialPaState`; the configurable is resolved inside the wrapper node, not the pure function.

---

## 9. UI Surfaces

### 9.1 Queue workspace — exception panel extension

The existing exception panel (Operate view) gains a **Documentation Gaps** section when `awaiting_documentation = true`:

- Lists each `DocumentationGap` with `item_text` and a badge indicating item type
- Each gap shows `existing_answer` if partially filled, or an "⚠ Unanswered" label
- A **Supply Documents** CTA opens a modal where the operator attaches evidence (`CriterionResult` additions)
- On submission, the modal calls `POST /api/pa/supply-docs` via the typed client and streams the re-entry events
- A `crd_resolution` badge is shown on every initial-PA case card: "Payer CRD" (green), "Registry Fallback" (amber), "Not Required" (grey)

### 9.2 Scenario fixture updates

`src/data/scenarios.tsx` gains one new initial-PA scenario where the CRD fires DTR and the first pass enters `awaiting_documentation`. The scenario fixture demonstrates the supply-docs re-entry path in the offline demo (simulated, no backend).

### 9.3 Single-shell capability manifest

The `supply-docs` endpoint and the DTR gap view are added to `src/capabilities.ts` as a new unit `O14` (`"dtr_gap_resolution"`), initially `simulated`. It becomes `live` once the supply-docs endpoint is confirmed working in the integration environment.

---

## 10. Test Cases

### 10.1 Unit tests

| Test module | Cases |
|-------------|-------|
| `tests/unit/test_crd_client.py` | Mock CRD endpoint returns PA required + questionnaire ref; mock returns not-required; network timeout → fallback; circuit breaker trips on 3 consecutive failures; PHI in CDS context → redacted before log |
| `tests/unit/test_dtr_check_node.py` | All criteria answered → gaps empty; one mandatory boolean item unanswered → gap emitted; optional item unanswered → not a gap; questionnaire ref absent → pass-through; CRD resolution field correctly propagated |
| `tests/unit/test_awaiting_doc_finalize.py` | Terminal event shape; `awaiting_documentation = true`; `AuditRecord.outcome = "awaiting_documentation"` |
| `tests/unit/test_supply_docs.py` | Merge additional_criteria; gaps resolved after supply → pa_assembly proceeds; gaps persist after supply → new awaiting_documentation terminal; unknown correlation_id → error; already-resolved → error (idempotent) |
| `tests/unit/test_schema_parity.py` | NEW assertions for `CrdResolution`, `AuditOutcome.awaiting_documentation`, `AuditProvenance.documentation_supplied` TS mirror |

### 10.2 Integration tests

| Test | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `tests/integration/test_pa_pipeline_crd.py` | Full CRD→DTR→PAS run with mock CRD server; all step events in order; terminal carries `crd_resolution = "payer_crd"` |
| `tests/integration/test_pa_pipeline_dtr_gap.py` | DTR returns gaps; terminal `awaiting_documentation = true`; `POST supply-docs` merges evidence; re-entry clears gaps; final terminal `awaiting_documentation = false`, `outcome` set |
| `tests/integration/test_pa_pipeline_fallback.py` | CRD unavailable; pipeline falls back to registry; `crd_resolution = "registry_fallback"`; rest of flow unchanged |

### 10.3 Contract tests

- `test_schema_parity.py` extended: `CrdResolution`, `DocumentationGap`, `FhirQuestionnaireRef`, `SupplyDocsRequest` all present in both Python and TypeScript
- `test_fhi_compat.py` unchanged (CRD client is a new adapter, not touching the fhi fork)
- Wire-types freshness CI job: `openapi.json` regenerated after new route and new models

### 10.4 Security tests

- `test_prompt_injection.py` extended: PHI in CRD hook context → `redact_phi()` called before any log; adversarial questionnaire item text (injection phrases) → sanitized before storage
- `test_auth_middleware.py`: `POST /api/pa/supply-docs` requires auth; cookie write requires CSRF; Bearer does not

---

## 11. Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|------------|--------|------------|
| Payer CRD endpoints return non-standard FHIR Questionnaire item types beyond the three in scope | Medium | Medium | Unrecognized item types are logged as warnings and treated as optional (fail-open); a future slice extends the parser |
| Registry-fallback false negatives in production persist after CRD is configured (misconfigured `PAYER_CRD_BASE_URL`) | Medium | High | Circuit breaker opens on repeated failure; `crd_resolution = "registry_fallback"` is recorded in `AuditRecord` and surfaced in the audit trail UI, making misconfiguration visible |
| `InMemorySaver` on the PA graph shards under multi-worker deploy (same as the appeal graph today) | High (pre-Phase 3) | High | Documented in ADR-0010; mitigated by single-worker constraint until Phase 3 PostgreSQL checkpointer lands. Supply-docs re-entry must reach the same worker — a sticky session or Phase 3 is required before multi-worker |
| FHIR token management for payer CRD auth grows into a full SMART-on-FHIR implementation | Low | High | NG1 explicitly defers this; the pre-provisioned static token is the only auth method in scope; a new ADR gates any SMART flow |
| DTR questionnaire evaluation logic is complex enough to hide false-clears | Medium | High | 100% branch coverage requirement (NF2); golden-set questionnaire fixture with planted mandatory gap; independent review pass before merge |

---

## 12. Deliverables

| # | Deliverable | Acceptance Criteria |
|---|-------------|---------------------|
| D1 | `etl/crd/client.py` — injectable CRD HTTP client with circuit breaker and 10s timeout | Unit tests pass; mock client works in integration; PHI redacted before logs |
| D2 | `etl/crd/questionnaire_parser.py` — FHIR Questionnaire → `DocumentationGap[]` mapper | 100% branch coverage; handles boolean/choice/text; ignores unknown types with warning |
| D3 | `agents/nodes/dtr_check.py` — pure DTR evaluation node | Node contract `(InitialPaState) → InitialPaState`; no I/O inside pure function |
| D4 | `agents/nodes/awaiting_doc_finalize.py` — terminal node for gap path; parks via `interrupt()` | AuditRecord written before terminal event; `awaiting_documentation = true` on DoneEvent |
| D5 | `agents/supply_docs.py` — `run_supply_docs()` re-entry function | Merges evidence; re-enters graph at `dtr_check`; writes `documentation_supplied` AuditRecord |
| D6 | `POST /api/pa/supply-docs` route in `main.py` | Auth enforced; 200 = stream started; error on unknown/resolved correlation_id |
| D7 | Updated `InitialPaState`, `InitialPaDoneEvent`, `AuditRecord` schemas | Parity test passes; wire types freshness gate passes |
| D8 | `src/types.ts` parity additions + `src/lib/wire.ts` update | `test_schema_parity.py` green; typed client compiles |
| D9 | Queue workspace DTR gap panel + supply-docs modal | Renders in offline demo; calls live endpoint in live mode; `O14` capability unit in manifest |
| D10 | Full test suite (unit + integration + contract + security) | All CI gates green; 100% branch coverage on questionnaire parser; no regressions |
| D11 | `.env.example` updated; ADR written for CRD client design | ADR merged before feature branch opens |
| D12 | Docs updated: `02-backend-architecture.md`, `03-domain-model.md`, `05-state-lifecycle.md`, `06-api-contract.md` | All five struct-change docs in same PR |
